headline: Executive order directing federal agencies to improve and expand access to COVID-19 care and treatments.
what_it_does: This executive order tells federal agencies to take steps to make COVID-19 care and treatments easier to get. No summary was provided, so the specific actions, programs, and agencies involved are not described here. Based on the title, it focuses on medical care and treatment for COVID-19, not on vaccines or other topics.

who_it_affects.how: The order aims to make COVID-19 care and treatments easier for them to get.
They are directed to take steps to improve and expand access to COVID-19 care and treatments.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed January 21, 2021; executive orders generally take effect when signed.
